rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when people or things move apart in different directions.

example.english: The crowd began to disperse in all directions.
example.traditional: 人群一見到警察就即刻向四方八面散開。
example.jyutping: jan4 kwan4 jat1 gin3 dou2 ging2 caat3 zau6 zik1 hak1 hoeng3 sei3 fong1 baat3 min6 saan3 hoi1

rows.note: Use this when people or things are distributed throughout different places rather than simply moving apart.

example.english: The staff helped disperse the supplies among the different shelters.
example.traditional: 工作人員將物資分散到各個避難中心。
example.jyutping: gung1 zok3 jan4 jyun4 zoeng1 mat6 zi1 fan1 saan3 dou3 gok3 go3 bei6 naan6 zung1 sam1

rows.note: Use this when a crowd breaks up or smoke, mist, or a similar thing dissipates and disappears.

example.english: The smoke slowly began to disperse, and we could finally see clearly.
example.traditional: 煙霧慢慢散咗，終於睇得清楚喇。
example.jyutping: jin1 mou6 maan6 maan2 saan3 zo2 zung1 jyu1 dai6 dak1 cing1 co2 laa3
